name: ReportWright Torture Test
description: Synthetic lending portfolio (180 loans, 12 months) that exercises every feature a report engine must get right: cover links and QR, numbered contents and PDF outline, KPIs, pivot, combo/donut/bucket charts, a grouped register with sparklines, data bars, interactive sort and drill-down, and drill-through detail pages with Code 128 barcodes.

items.name: CoverHowTo
items.value: In the viewer: change the parameters (regions, statuses, minimum outstanding), click a register column header to sort, collapse a region, and click a watchlist loan to jump to its detail page. In the PDF: the outline (bookmarks panel) lists every section, and the cover links open in a browser.

items.name: Methodology
items.value:
How the numbers are made

The portfolio has {CountRows("AllLoans")} loans across five regions and five products. Each loan is simulated month by month from its disbursal: interest on the opening balance at rate ÷ 1200, then the payment. Before the 12-month window every installment is paid in full; inside it, Overdue and NPA loans pay several partial installments, and Closed loans pay a few partials and then settle the balance.

  • EMI: the standard amortising installment, P·i·(1+i)n ÷ ((1+i)n − 1), rounded to the paisa.
  • Collection efficiency: amount collected ÷ amount due in the month. Settlements of Closed loans count as collections, so a month can exceed 100%.
  • Overdue: days past due above {First(Fields.overdueThresholdDays, "Meta")}. NPA: over 180 days past due. Ratios are shares of outstanding.
  • DPD buckets: 0, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+.

Data is synthetic (seed {First(Fields.seed, "Meta")}). Parameters filter the KPIs, the pivot, the status and DPD charts and the register; the monthly series and the drill-through pages always show the whole book.
